LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS (LISTENING AND SPEAKING) 2.1.1 CRITICAL LISTENING AND OBSERVING

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Observing and Articulating signs (Listening and Speaking) 2.1.1 Critical Listening and Observing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs (Listening and Speaking) 2.1.1 Critical Listening and Observing, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: how to identify the speaker, context and intention and receive peer review. 1. How can we ensure we gain the most out of a signed or a listening text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs (Listening and Speaking) 2.1.1 Critical Listening and Observing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: The learner will generate new ideas as they brainstorm on different forms of distractions

and how to avoid them.

● Communication and collaboration: The learner will observe or listen critically and show awareness of the speaker,

context and intention in varied signed or oral texts.

Values:
● Responsibility: The learners engage in assigned duties and roles as they collaboratively search for information online

and offline on how to identify the speaker, context and intention.

● Love: The learner portrays a caring attitude as they brainstorm different forms of distractions and how to avoid them.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Sign Language Dictionary or Apps, Adapted textbooks, Video Clips of Signed Texts for information, Visual Aids,

Discussion Guides, digital devices, online and offline materials, Hearing aids.
